entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that serves as a universal memory layer for AI Agents. It supports multi-level memory for User, Session, and Agent states through temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval.

entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated brain for Hermes Agents that provides synthesized answers with citations and gap analysis. It supports multi-user scoping for team institutional memory and creates typed edges without LLM calls.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system designed for long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It is available via Python and Node.js client SDKs and offers Docker-based deployment options.

entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages context trees using git-like version control via brv vc commit, branch, and merge. It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI/REPL interface.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system that utilizes a single SQLite database for sub-millisecond performance. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and provides a Python SDK for direct memory operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: A seven-layer memory system that combines vector search and structured facts with an auto-curated wiki. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that provides filesystem-first traces, reports, and datasets. It supports multiple agent providers, including Pi and MCP clients, and includes CLI tools for task investigation.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a DAG-based engine to ensure no message is lost. It utilizes a SQLite message store with FTS metadata to build depth-aware summary nodes.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend for Honcho that enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider via a Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis setup.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open engram YAML format to store memory as plain-text. It supports MCP tools like Claude Code and Cursor while providing local-first, zero-cost search for multi-agent systems.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer manages identity, memory, and secrets to provide portable state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and various MCP clients. It includes specialized tools for inspecting, editing, and deleting memory and reports a 97.6% average LongMemEval answer accuracy.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates fully locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It utilizes hybrid retrieval via BM25 and vector search to support Hermes agents, Claude Code, and OpenClaw.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This tool optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse. It reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% in tokens, featuring native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This durable, file-based architecture uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of a vector database or embeddings. It is delivered via a five-package plugin family that includes a Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a why_retrieved tag to every recall. It tracks contradictions using conflict and resolution primitives and supports both embedded in-process mode and HTTP backends.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system uses RAG and vector search to prefetch context by monitoring agent session logs. It features an MCP-native server and local-first storage using SQLite-vec and GGUF models.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It manages state and retrieval through SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma, providing a purpose-built evidence packet to the agent per query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system uses semantic search with BM25 full-text and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for URLs, codebases, and multimedia with OCR support, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces prompt token overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 through local BM25 tool ranking and keyword selection. It includes a dashboard to track estimated savings in tool-schema tokens.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This local-first context layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to reduce prompt tokens by 94%. It supports MCP-native exposure via SSE or stdio and requires no account or hosted service.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This daemonless memory system stores information as inspectable Markdown files to allow users to use an Obsidian vault as a source of truth. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports Codex and Claude Code.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database to manage memories. It features BM25-first retrieval and an importance ranking system from 1-10 to surface high-priority information during context prefetch.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This plugin implements a pull-model episodic memory system that supports immediate event deletion and an on-demand summarizer. It provides an audit trace of all memory operations via a trace.jsonl log.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider offers durable, cross-session memory storage with semantic search capabilities. It includes specialized tools for remembering, searching, and updating state to maintain continuity across agents.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables API charging for AI agents using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates directly with Hermes to facilitate automated payments.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It supports manual memory storage, searching, and configurable query expansion and reranking.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin provides local capability indexing and routing through five native tools for searching and reporting on artifacts. It supports indexing for scripts, markdown documents, cron jobs, skills, and MCP servers.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider features 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It utilizes a hybrid search approach combining BM25, vector, and graph methods alongside automatic context checkpointing.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This local plugin enables private code memory for repositories through semantic and literal code search. It supports grounded Q&A that includes specific file-and-line citations.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native long-term memory solution includes AES-256-GCM encryption at rest by default. It supports HNSW ANN, sparse and exact-text recall, and MinHash for near-duplicate detection.
